native_cpp_pthread_tsan.scope: Native TSan build of the same browser-patched C++ with NEON scoring. Does not instrument browser JavaScript.

integration: nested worker tree removed on cancellation
nonzero engine exit reported without hanging
first-visit UI waits for isolation reload
old job manifests without thread metadata use serial engine
limitations: Only backbone HMM genome-pair work is parallel; other alignment stages remain serial.
Synthetic timings are workload-specific, with two repeats per configuration.
Chrome tested; other browsers select threads only when isolation and shared memory are available.
Browser peak memory was not measured.

allocator_experiment.note: One mimalloc trial completed in 29.88 s at eight threads, approximately 1% faster than the initial default-allocator median; no compelling measured improvement.

deployment: Local implementation and assets prepared; not committed, pushed, or deployed.
